gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads chunky and sure, like chalk pressed hard. Starborn drifts overhead, dreamy and full of blank space between letters, while that heavy body keeps the lines grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-open-sans: Dreamy gaps and dark lowercase make Starborn feel like night sky. Open Sans then reads smoothly, its bulky lowercase and unclogged curves letting paragraph after paragraph go down easily.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-saira: Starborn drifts along with dreamy, wide gaps between every letter. Saira grounds it with rounded letters that stretch toward the top line and a see-through gap in each s.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans is ruler-drawn, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals. Starborn is best at floating dreamy, widely spaced letters; Vend Sans is best at filling the line with its tall x-height.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as capitals. Stencilia earns its keep big and brief, where its structural, striking letters and wide curve gaps get room to show.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Stencilia is all structure, with wide gaps at its curve ends. Give Stencilia big sizes and let Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, with lowercase eyes as big as washers, stay modest in size.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Structural and striking, Stencilia leaves generous gaps at its curve ends. Where the heading makes its statement, Carrois Gothic SC keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level, with clear curve openings.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-chivo: Stencilia hits hard, with wide gaps at every curve end. Chivo, a sans-serif, is better at quiet duty, its lowercase packed toward the caps and daylight showing through every curve.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, its curves never clogged and its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Under the Stencilia headings, paragraphs glide along without snagging on a single curve.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives each lowercase e a wide-eyed look, with n arches matching their stems and a prominent x-height. Beneath Stencilia, the text flows smoothly, with no tapering to catch the eye.
